# Asdsoft Labs

> Boutique senior product team. We bridge business and code: web and mobile development, IT recruiting, SEO, and AI agents & automations with human oversight. Based in Aguascalientes, Mexico.

Key people: Asdrúbal Chirinos (CEO & Founder), Fabiola Márquez (Talent Lead), Beatriz Márquez (Business Lead).

## Services

- Web & mobile product development (modern stacks, code you own)
- UX/UI & web design focused on conversion
- IT recruiting: sourcing, screening, and managing tech talent
- SEO & AI search visibility
- AI agents & automations (chatbots, lead qualification, workflows) with human review on critical steps

## Approach

- Purpose first: we start with why; every feature traces back to a business goal
- Vision meets execution: stakeholders and developers aligned
- Business and code, together

## Selected work

- P1 Express App: minimalist, offline-first planning app (https://p1express.app)
